Anton Serrano
anton.serrano@example.com | San Jose, CA
Anton Serrano has 14 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Principal Backend Engineer at Windmere Data (2025-2026), where
they owned the Kafka event pipeline processing 45M events/day. Before that,
Staff Backend Engineer at Copperfield Infrastructure (2022-2025). Before that,
Senior Backend Engineer at Lattice Technologies (2012-2022). Education: Ph.D.
Computer Engineering, NC State University, 2012; B.S. Computer Engineering, Cal
Poly, 2007. Core skills: GraphQL, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, CI/CD, Kafka,
Node.js, Go, AWS, Distributed systems.
